title: Introduce token-cost cohort sampler and alert gatekeeper
author: Priya Khandelwal
description: Motivation: alert noise from token-cost spikes is drowning out actionable SLO regressions and inflating on-call toil. This change implements a cohort-aware token-cost sampler and an alert gatekeeper that reduces noisy alerts by attenuating signals for low-confidence cohorts while preserving high-fidelity alerts for golden routes. Design: introduce a CohortSampler service that deterministically maps invocations to coarse cohorts (route, model_variant, tenant_tier, prompt_shape_bucket) and attaches a cohort_id to sampled spans and metrics. CohortSampler supports time-windowed reservoir sampling, configurable per-cohort sample rate, and cost-weighted amplification so high-cost invocations have higher sampling chance. The Alert Gatekeeper consumes aggregated cohort rollups and applies attenuation rules: 1) suppress alerts for cohorts below a cost-confidence threshold unless multiple cohorts report correlated regressions; 2) escalate aggregated-lifetime regressions that cross a global severity threshold; 3) expose a debug flag to force-pass alerts for a single tenant for debugging. Configuration: new observability config map Telemetry.CohortSampler {window_seconds, default_sample_rate, cost_weight_factor, cohort_keys} and AlertGatekeeper.Policies {min_cohort_cost_usd, correlation_window, amplify_on_correlation}. Implementation notes: added a lightweight Go service observability/cohort_sampler that runs alongside the telemetry aggregator; extended trace enrichment to include cohort_id when present; added cohort rollup exporter that writes compact cohort summaries to the metrics plane (meters.coho_rollup.*). Compatibility: defaults are conservative (low sample rates) and gatekeeper defaults to pass-through for existing high-severity alerts. Rollout plan: staged rollout by region and tenant tier over two weeks; start sampling for internal and canary tenants only, validate alert reduction in staging dashboards, then enable broader cohorts. Testing: unit tests for sampling correctness, e2e with synthetic replay harness (observability/replaybench) to validate preservation of top-k cost contributors, and CHAOS run to ensure gatekeeper does not drop P0 alerts. Related: references ENG-2483 for sampling heuristics and SUP-8812 for incident context.

review_comments: Ethan Zhao: Looks good overall. Two asks: add bounds checks for extreme cost_weight_factor values and include a metric for 'cohort_samples_skipped' so we can audit suppression. Response: added bounds (0.1-100) and new meter telemetry.coho_sampler.skipped_count in commit 3.

Marcel Nguyen: Gatekeeper is clever but we need a safe fallback. Please add a feature flag that can be flipped from the console and a fail-open behavior. Response: added 'feature.gatekeeper.enabled' with fail_open=true default; documented in docs/observability/cohort-sampling.md.

Lina Park: Unit tests look good; saw a CI flake in replaybench where synthetic traces were not timestamped correctly causing a windowing miss. Priya: fixed timestamp generation and added a deterministic seed for replaybench runs; re-ran CI.
QA (internal): Verified in staging that alerts for low-confidence cohorts dropped by ~72% while P0 alerts remained intact. Noted slight uptick in metrics CPU for telemetry aggregator (+6%).

release_notes: Adds cohort-based token-cost sampling and an alert gatekeeper to reduce noisy cost/latency alerts. Defaults are conservative; admins can tune sampling and attenuation via Telemetry.CohortSampler and AlertGatekeeper config. Improves signal-to-noise for SLO regressions while preserving high-severity alerts.
post_deploy_observations: During canary: cohort sample rate at 1% for non-canary tenants; alert volume reduced by 48% for INFO/P1 channels in staging. Observed a small +6% CPU in aggregator pod; autoscaler threshold increased by 5% for telemetry pods in canary cluster.
rollback_plan: Feature flag 'feature.gatekeeper.enabled' can be toggled to disable gatekeeper. CohortSampler can be turned off by setting default_sample_rate=0. Revert commits are small and scoped to observability subtrees if emergency rollback required.
notes_for_oncall: If you see suppressed alerts and need full fidelity, flip feature.gatekeeper.enabled=false and set Telemetry.CohortSampler.default_sample_rate=1. Check meters 'telemetry.coho_rollup.*' and 'telemetry.coho_sampler.skipped_count' to audit behavior. If replaybench shows missing top-k contributors, check cohort hashing seed in config.
